name: nse-picks
description: NSE daily quantitative stock-selection system: NestJS API + React dashboard

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w api && npm run build -w web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run start:dev -w api
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run start:dev -w api" "npm run dev -w web"
